$comment: Made by go test ./tools/internal/thumbhash -update, from its encoder and decoder: what Clack's decoder (src/thumbhash.ts) must make of each. "base64" gives texts and their bytes in hex, or null where they must be refused. "refused" gives hashes, in hex, that must be refused: too short for what their headers say, or of no width or height. "images" gives test images (made in that test) by name and size, the hash of each in hex, and what the hash draws: its size and its pixels as RGBA, in hex, each of which Clack's may differ from by one, as cosines differ slightly between engines.
